text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [AUTO] autoscaler alert for gcp-us-west3: GPU softlimit reached. scale-up attempts returning quota_pending / REQUESTED. Current pending GPU requests: 48. Queue growth on inference-frontend.

eric: seeing massive increase in generation queue, p95 token latency spiking. some requests timing out with 503s.

maya: on it. checking k8s events + cloud quota. `kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase==Pending -n redwood-inference` shows many pending with reason=InsufficientGPUs.

anna: confirmed: cloud quota shows GPUs at soft limit for project redwood-prod-usw3. gcloud returns `QUOTA_EXCEEDED: resource 'GPUS' softlimit` on new instance create.

eric: customers affected? CS slack says 3 customers reported errors, multiple internal errors for queued requests.

lee: collecting impact: customer A (high-volume), some requests dropped, they see ~20% error rate on heavy routes. others increased latency 2-3x.

maya: quick mitigation options: 1) route some traffic to eu-west1; 2) enable fallback to cpu-encoded smaller model; 3) evict noncritical batch jobs; 4) request emergency quota bump with GCP. doing 1+2 immediately.

eric: please run the divert and fallback. tag me when done.

deploy-bot: :gear: canary redirect triggered by maya -> route 20% of traffic for route /v1/generate to eu-west1-dry-run.

maya: fallback toggle for small-llm-cpu is ON for routes: /v1/generate/fast and /v1/embeddings.

anna: evicting warmpool jobs now: `kubectl delete job batch-warmpool -n batch` (will reduce GPU pressure by ~6 nodes).

eric: good. also enable autoscaler fallback policy to allow smaller-instance SKUs where possible (q4-policy).

maya: opened internal incident ticket RED-9876, and filed GCP support case 20012345 (priority P1) requesting immediate quota increase for GPUs in us-west3. attached logs and demand spike chart.

anna: note: many nodes stuck in PROVISIONING at the compute API layer with error `RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: quota pending approval`. autoscaler retries every 30s.

eric: can we temporarily lower per-request concurrency to reduce queue drain? set instance_concurrency=1 on heavy routes for 10m.

maya: doing that now.

[code block]
# to reduce concurrency on the route
redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate --concurrency 1 --duration 10m
[/code block]

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: route concurrency update applied.

lee: customer comms: posting incident note to status page draft: "We are experiencing elevated errors and latency in gcp-us-west3 due to GPU provisioning delays. Traffic is being routed to alternate regions and fallbacks enabled. Engineers are working on a fix."

eric: thanks. ping me when GCP responds. also run cost check for increased EU usage.

maya: initial telemetry: queue size peaked 62 -> now ~28 after mitigation. errors down from 22% -> 7% for diverted routes. still elevated on cpu fallback routes (latency up).

anna: GCP support acked case 20012345, asking for justification + expected sustained/peak vCPU+GPU numbers. I've sent the demand profile + can share the spreadsheet.

eric: good. next steps: keep diversion 20%, keep fallback on, continue evictions, monitor queue. prepare for manual capacity reclaim if needed.

maya: handoff to tom for night shift. I'm putting runbook notes in the ticket (what we toggled, commands, dashboard links).

tom: taking it. will monitor for 2 hours then re-evaluate. @eric @maya -- if GCP doesn't grant the bump in 30m, escalate to infra-sre lead and consider switching more traffic to eu-west1 (50%).

eric: acknowledged. thanks team.

incident-bot: :information_source: incident updated: RED-9876 status = mitigation in progress; assigned to tom.

maya: quick checklist added to RED-9876: `- divert 20% -> eu-west1`, `- enable small-llm-cpu fallback`, `- evict batch warmpools`, `- lower concurrency`, `- open GCP case`, `- inform CS + status page`.

tom: leaving last note before watch: monitor `queue_length`, `pending_pods`, `gcp_quota_usage` dashboards; call if queue > 40 or pending_pods > 15.

lee: posted status page update. customers notified via email for top 5 accounts.

eric: closing loop: we'll keep this thread updated. planning a post-incident writeup after resolution.

deploy-bot: :truck: automated canary revert scheduled in 2h unless updated.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: last_manifest: mitigation actions ongoing. follow-up: escalate to platform infra if GCP response delayed beyond 45m.
